items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I did the same thing when I did it with Louie Armstrong. With Louie, I built Louie a complete new band.

ctx.x: So, this is the same thing what we do with bands. I did it with, (inaudible), when I did it with Cab.
I did the same thing when I did it with Louie Armstrong. With Louie, I built Louie a complete new band. That was a different type of thing.
Joe Glaser wanted to get rid of the old band. He didn't want nobody in the old band, because he said the band wore its use out.
